name: Machir
bio: Machir son of Ammiel was a man of Lo-debar who had been sheltering Jonathan's crippled son Mephibosheth; David sent and brought Mephibosheth from his house to show him kindness for Jonathan's sake (2 Samuel 9:4-5). Machir later showed the same generosity to David himself: when David, exhausted from fleeing Absalom's rebellion, reached Mahanaim, Machir joined Shobi son of Nahash and Barzillai the Gileadite in bringing beds, bowls, pottery, grain, and food for David and his famished people (2 Samuel 17:27-29).
